snippet.title: Master of Monsters: Disciples of Gaia - [Story Mode] 100% Playthrough using Justice
snippet.description:
All episodes except two were done in less than double-digit turns. Due to having bad RNG when attacking enemies, some episodes actually took one or two extra turns than what I called the best possible scenario. If you are lucky, it's also possible to play without saving the game at all, because I noticed there are at least two separate moments when luck is pretty much required in order to deal with the problem.
